take: The Kings announced they placed right wing Mats Zuccarello on injured reserve. He was the second-line forward at 16:22 a night and on the first power-play unit, and Joel Armia (13:54 a night) is next in line for his minutes, with Corey Perry the likeliest to move up on the power play. Zuccarello had one assist in six games, and LAK's share of the chances at five-on-five (expected goals share) was 31% with him on the ice. The Kings are 2-5-2, so the depth has to carry more now.
